name: Mohammedi Special Shawarma Roll
tagline: Spit-roasted sliced chicken in toasted flatbread
description: Slow-roasted vertical spit chicken shavings layered with velvety garlic toum, golden crispy potato batons, and traditional pickled ruby beetroot wrapped in charred artisanal bread.

name: Crispy Fried Tenders Platter
tagline: 6x ultra-crunch marinated fillets with trio dip array
description: Golden double-crunch chicken tenderloins seasoned with secret 52-herb spice rub, served alongside toasted pita slices, fresh shredded slaw, garlic mayo, spicy dynamite sauce, and tangy honey mustard.

name: Fiery Wok Schezwan Chicken Noodles
tagline: High-heat wok-tossed Hakka noodles with charred peppers
description: Springy egg noodles tossed in a smoking iron wok over red flames with diced chicken tikka chunks, vibrant tri-color bell peppers, scallions, and house-infused fiery Schezwan chili oil.

name: Café 52 Triple Club Grilled Sandwich
tagline: 3-tier whole wheat toasted sandwich with spicy chicken & cheese
description: Stacked layers of toasted artisanal loaf stuffed with roasted shredded spiced chicken tikka, molten mozzarella-cheddar blend, and crispy golden fries served with sweet tomato reduction.

name: Spicy Schezwan Chicken Fried Rice
tagline: Fragrant basmati wok tossed with roasted chicken & egg
description: Fluffy aged basmati rice tossed vigorously on high flames with aromatic ginger, garlic, cubed marinated chicken, scrambled egg ribbons, and rich toasted red chili spice.

name: Wok-Glazed Chilli Chicken Dry
tagline: Crispy caramelized chicken cubes with spring onions & capsicum
description: Crispy batter-fried chicken bites glazed in a dark soya and chili reduction with crunchy bell pepper diamonds, sweet red onion petals, and fresh green spring onions.

name: Cheesy Egg & Herb Grilled Toast
tagline: Golden butter-toasted sandwich with fluffy spiced omelette
description: Pan-seared seeded brown loaf stuffed with a thick fluffy masala omelette loaded with chopped herbs, green chilies, and a lavish crown of freshly grated cheddar cheese.

name: Peri-Peri Crispy French Fries Bowl
tagline: Skin-on golden fries dusted in zesty African bird’s eye seasoning
description: Crisp hot french fries tossed in an aromatic blend of dried chili flakes, citrus peel powder, and peri-peri seasoning, served with a dual bowl of cheesy cocktail mayo and rich tomato ketchup.

name: Open Shawarma Loaded Fries Platter
tagline: Deconstructed shawarma feast over fries with garlic toum & beetroot
description: Generous platter of golden fries smothered with spiced roasted chicken shawarma meat, drenched in velvety white garlic toum and yellow cheese drizzle, topped with crunchy pickled beetroot.

name: Galouti Shami Cutlets Platter
tagline: Silky melt-in-mouth pan-seared patties with crispy potato fries
description: Slow-simmered tender meat and lentil patties ground with fragrant Awadhi aromatics, pan-crisped to perfection, quartered and served alongside crispy french fries.

name: Artisan 52 Neon Latte Coffee
tagline: Specialty double espresso with glowing 52 microfoam latte art
description: Single-origin Ethiopian highland beans pulled into a dense golden crema, topped with silky microfoam hand-poured with the iconic 52 emblem and dusting of cinnamon starlight.

name: Royal Mohammedi 24K Gold Sweets
tagline: Signature handcrafted luxury confectionery with pure edible gold
description: Heritage delicacy crafted from rich reduced milk solids, infused with Kashmiri saffron strands, Iranian pistachio slivers, and finished with delicate 24-karat edible gold leaf.
